author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a phone (rounded rectangle with a home-bar line) at the top-right, sitting in front of a larger browser window whose top edge, title-bar line and right side stop 9 short of it, as in the reference. A first candidate (narrower window x 6..40, lower top edge) was close to the rejected drawing and read more like a letter E, so the window was widened to the right edge and raised to give it a larger content area.
omissions: The phone's home bar sits 8 above the bottom (the reference places it lower) so its lower cell stays open at 48px.
drawing_plan: Phone r3 rect x 30..42, y 6..26, bar y=18; window r3 rect x 6..42, y 12..42, title bar y=20, top edge and title bar stop at x=21, right side starts at y=35.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'app-window' (rounded window with title-bar line) and 'smartphone' (rounded tall rectangle with bar).
